title: SSC CGL 2026 11
description:
Staff Selection Commission has released the official notification for Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2024. Candidates who are interested and eligible can apply online from the official website.

Important Dates:

Application Begin: 24/06/2024

Last Date for Apply Online: 24/07/2024

Last Date for Exam Fee Deposit: 25/07/2024

Exam Date (Tier-I): September/October 2024

Application Fee:

General/OBC: $100

SC/ST/Female: $0

Age Limit (as on 01/08/2024):

Minimum Age: 18 years

Maximum Age: 27 years
